content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The automated delivery pipeline for digital products follows a specific sequence that eliminates every manual step. A buyer visits the storefront, selects a product, and initiates payment. The checkout displays a QR code with the exact wallet address and payment amount in their chosen cryptocurrency, converted from USD at the current exchange rate via live price feeds. The buyer sends the payment from their wallet. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction within seconds of broadcast. When the transaction receives sufficient confirmations on-chain, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the payment amount, confirms the transaction hash on the blockchain directly, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the download link to the buyer's email address.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core of this infrastructure consists of free hosting, backend logic, order management, and file delivery systems. Utilizing Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for hosting, combined with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend processing, ensures reliability. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, while products are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments takes care of crypto transactions, charging only 0.5% compared to competitors like Gumroad, which charges 10%.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or prohibitively expensive. If you are a designer, educator, or developer looking to sell assets like ebooks, templates, or software, this infrastructure empowers you to operate independently, allowing for sustainable income without the burden of high platform fees. It's a strategic choice for those seeking to maximize their earnings.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, saving you significant revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components include hosting platforms, backend processing tools, payment gateways, and file storage solutions. Each part plays a crucial role: the hosting serves your website, the backend handles order processing, NOWPayments facilitates crypto transactions, and storage systems ensure your digital assets are delivered seamlessly. By integrating these elements, you create a cohesive digital commerce stack that operates efficiently and securely.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your sovereign commerce stack, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. After that, set up order management with Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing and upload your digital assets to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Your digital assets and data remain fully under your control.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a competitive fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than many traditional payment processors, making it an attractive option for digital creators.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

By using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for storage along with backend tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of your digital products as soon as a payment is confirmed.
